svg.aria-label: The ArXiv curator as a hub: the agent in the centre, four numbered stages clockwise around it. 1 prepare the data (a scheduled Lakeflow job builds a vector search index and a Genie space the agent reaches as Managed MCP tools), 2 deploy the agent (an on-demand job logs, registers and deploys it), 3 call the endpoint (a Databricks app), 4 monitor (a scheduled job reads the inference tables and MLflow traces, runs the evaluation and refreshes the dashboard).
svg.title: The ArXiv curator

g.text: Databricks app or model serving endpoint
